title: App classes come from local CSS Modules
intent: Paint follows the palette, and a framework control keeps the styling and focus treatment it ships with, so a control looks and behaves the same in every app. Inline style and a hardcoded colour in app script paint around the palette, and a class on a framework control, or ink and type an element passes down to the framework component it holds, restyle what the framework owns. So a CSS Module's binding is read only in a className on a native element, naming a class the module defines or choosing between two of them, and a class that sets an inherited property is refused on an element that holds a framework component; a framework control is configured through its props. Inline style, any other class name or read of the binding, and colour literals in app script are refused.
reference: Layout via Stack, Grid, DetailList and the page archetypes from @terpjs/react-core. A layout a component owns: import styles from "./Board.module.css" and className={styles.board}, or className={active ? styles.active : styles.board}, on a native element in the body of a plain Page, with ink and type on the element that holds the app's own text. Paint via the design tokens.

runtime.rationale: Most of the rule is erased before the app serves: react-core sets inline styles of its own, and a CSS Module's class is a hashed name like any other in the built DOM, so neither a style nor a class on a native element can be attributed to app authorship there. One part can be. Every react-core control's root carries a data-terp marker and react-core renders no class on it, save the router's active link, so a class on a framework control is observable in the running page, on the seam the archetype slot check (verifySlotChildren) already walks by those markers. A refusal there has not shipped.
runtime.tracking: docs/decisions/0217-app-components-can-own-a-scoped-stylesheet.md in the reference implementation, the Consequences section: a runtime refusal of a class on a data-terp element, beside verifySlotChildren, flips this entry to required.
